title: Fix Homing & Overspeed Issues After Rotary Use - X Series
body_html:
Failure to Home or XY Axis Overspeed after Rotary Use - X Series

Problem Description

After switching from the rotary axis back to regular cutting mode, the machine cannot properly reset, the X and Y axes move at excessive speed, and the head hits the limits without stopping.

Solution

  1. Turn the Rotary Switch ON on the machine and power on the machine. Wait for approximately one minute until the main page appears on the control panel.
  2. Open LightBurn (or your laser software) and connect to the machine. Open the Rotary Setup window and disable the "Enable Rotary" option.
  3. Turn the Rotary Switch OFF on the machine.
  4. Finally, press the "Reset" button on the control panel.

The machine should now be able to reset and return to normal cutting operation.

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
